title: FRAM Data Pipeline
description: Software for processing and archiving observation data from the FRAM robotic telescopes (Photometric Robotic Atmospheric Monitor) operated by FZU Institute of Physics of the Czech Academy of Sciences. The pipeline extracts and validates metadata from FITS files, enriches it with image-derived quantities (FWHM, sky position, image statistics), generates InvenioRDM-compatible JSON records for bulk import, and publishes records to the Physica repository. Also includes safe recursive FITS tile-compression using fpack.
